motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Bureau of Engineering be authorized to accept and execute any necessary documents to receive grant funds from the State Department of Transportation (Caltrans) for the Bridge Preventative Maintenance Program (BPMP) and to submit invoices and reimbursement requests to Caltrans for eligible project expenditures. I FURTHER MOVE that the Bureau of Engineering be authorized to accept and deposit $948,146.75 in grant funds from Caltrans for BPMP Project 5006(838) into the Engineering Special Services Fund No. 682-50 and appropriate a like amount therein to a new account entitled "Bridge Preventative Maintenance Program - Project 5006(838)" for disbursement to fund preventative maintenance improvements to 10 bridges in the San Fernando Valley and to utilize $122,842.50 in local matching funds from the SB 1 Road Maintenance and Rehabilitation Program Special Fund or other eligible funding sources. I FURTHER MOVE that the Bureau of Engineering be authorized to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections/ clarifications/ changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
